title: polygala major var. baetica
intro: Polygala major var. baetica, commonly known as Iberis, is a plant species belonging to the Polygalaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Iberis include its potential to soothe skin conditions, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
